page_title: EVE 1-2 LIV | Everton v Liverpool 19/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+12' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by James Garner (Everton) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

90+10' 1 - 2 Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) outjumps the defenders inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a header into the middle of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:2.
90+10' The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

90+10' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+8' A wild pass somehow finds Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
90+8' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool).
90+6' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Tyrique George (Everton) heads on.
90' 11 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Jarrad Branthwaite leaves the pitch to be replaced by Michael Keane (Everton).
86' Substitution. Andrew Robertson makes way for Milos Kerkez (Liverpool).
85' The game is interrupted now, Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
84' Here's the change. Cody Gakpo leaves the pitch and Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) comes on as a substitute.
84' Arne Slot decides to make a substitution. Florian Wirtz will be replaced by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool).
83' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
82' The percentage of ball possession is – 44:56.
80' Here comes a substitution. Dwight McNeil is given a rest as he is replaced by Tyrique George (Everton).
78' The attendance is 52585.
78' Dwight McNeil (Everton) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
77' Wow, what an escape. Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
76' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
75' James Garner (Everton) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Chris Kavanagh who sees an offensive foul.
73' The medics signal that Beto (Everton) will take no further part in the game after possibly suffering concussion after that knock to the head. Thierno Barry sprints onto the pitch to replace him.
72' Alexander Isak goes off the pitch and Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) comes on.
71' Beto (Everton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
69' A cross from Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
67' Great individual play by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) ends with a shot from distance that flies well wide of the right post.

65' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) bursts inside the box, beats two defenders and produces a strike from the penalty spot. The shot has power, but lacks precision and the goalkeeper stops it easily. The scoreline remains the same.
65' 8:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
62' The linesman signals that Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
61' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance.
60' Dwight McNeil (Everton) beats several players before unleashing a long-range shot on goal that flies miles over the bar.
58' Arne Slot is forced to make a change. Giorgi Mamardashvili (Liverpool) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Frederick Woodman.
56' Giorgi Mamardashvili (Liverpool) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
54' 1 - 1 Beto (Everton) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.
53' Liverpool are awarded a free kick from long range.
50' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) commits a foul during an attacking move.
49' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
47' Liverpool keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
45+2' The keeper makes a simple save after Alexander Isak (Liverpool) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes.
42' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Liverpool.

42' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the roof of the net, but it wasn't dangerous and Jordan Pickford gathered easily. Liverpool get a corner.
40' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:2.
38' Beto (Everton) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
37' Everton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
37' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Everton earn a corner.
35' Great teamplay by Everton as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
34' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

33' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
29' 0 - 1 Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the bottom left corner.

29' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Jordan Pickford to get hold of the ball.
29' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Everton due to an offside in the build-up play.
28' Wait! Referee Chris Kavanagh has indicated he is going to review the Everton goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
27' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) converts a killer cross with a strong and precise shot that goes across the goal and past the goalkeeper.
26' Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off a glorious save! James Tarkowski (Everton) attempts to head home after a precise lofted cross. However, his effort only finds its way into the goalkeeper gloves.
22' Jordan Pickford (Everton) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
22' The resulting set piece from Liverpool is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
22' A corner kick by Liverpool is thwarted by the well prepared Jordan Pickford (Everton). The referee points to the corner flag and Liverpool will take a corner.

21' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
20' 44:56 – the ratio of ball possession.
18' Liverpool fail to score from a corner as Jordan Pickford (Everton) leaps to collect the ball.
18' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Liverpool force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
17' Dwight McNeil (Everton) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
16' Beto (Everton) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
16' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Everton was in an offside position.
15' James Garner (Everton) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Giorgi Mamardashvili to dive and make a save.
14' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Everton earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
14' Everton are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
12' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Everton for a penalty. Play continues.
11' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle after Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
10' The corner is swung in but Liverpool can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

6' Beto (Everton) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot low towards the middle of the net is denied by Giorgi Mamardashvili. This effort didn't really trouble him.
5' Liverpool hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
3' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Chris Kavanagh no option but to blow his whistle.
2' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
